scene.cause: Current semantic/provenance evidence equals the unchanged approved scene.
scene.reviewerRationale: Current exact source has 11 nodes. Source IDs and exported bounds were cross-checked on each surface; scene comparison passes. Personally inspected the exact embedded preview and all four current stored captures: the photo retains its subject and aspect, NOW/HIRING badges occupy the source corners, and headline/body/CTA retain their text, wrapping, hierarchy and olive/yellow paints. Current source-sized PNG differs from the source at the same 340 comparator pixels documented by the prior source review; exact managed font identities, source bounds and current placement evidence support retaining that bounded raster difference.
